// Generator of types-quality-oracle.json: what the Go build of the freeze
// commit (238e07f66d8cafab24ef363cb79e207bd48babd8) answers for the functions
// of types.javascript, types.strictness, quality.suppressions, quality.size and
// quality.metrics on the inputs of types-quality-oracle-cases.json: how
// Suppression comments are counted, the Inventory role of a path, the line
// counts, the percentile, the reading of type-coverage's document, what the
// type Checks make of tsc's output, what quality.metrics makes of a combined
// ESLint run, and the two native Checks run on a tree of files. Kept as text,
// because the functions are unexported; regenerate from the repository root
// with:
//
//	cp internal/checks/testdata/types-quality-oracle.go.txt internal/checks/zz_types_quality_oracle_test.go
//	go test ./internal/checks -run TestZZTypesQualityOracle -count=1 && rm internal/checks/zz_types_quality_oracle_test.go
package checks

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/invia-flights/jscript-bench/internal/resultset"
)

type ztCoverage struct {
	Correct int `json:"correct"`
	Total   int `json:"total"`
}

type ztRun struct {
	Out  string `json:"out"`
	Exit int    `json:"exit"`
	// Many generates Count diagnostics of Code in Path (a strict-mode error).
	Many *struct {
		Count int    `json:"count"`
		Path  string `json:"path"`
		Code  string `json:"code"`
	} `json:"many"`
	// Resolution adds that many unresolved modules (TS2307) in src/a.ts.
	Resolution int `json:"resolution"`
}

type ztCases struct {
	Suppressions []string `json:"suppressions"`
	Roles        []string `json:"roles"`
	Lines        []string `json:"lines"`
	Percentiles  []struct {
		Values []int `json:"values"`
		P      int   `json:"p"`
	} `json:"percentiles"`
	TypeCoverage []string `json:"typeCoverage"`
	Types        []struct {
		Name  string            `json:"name"`
		Files map[string]string `json:"files"`
		Pkg   string            `json:"pkg"`
		Run   ztRun             `json:"run"`
	} `json:"types"`
	Strictness []struct {
		Name   string            `json:"name"`
		Files  map[string]string `json:"files"`
		Basic  ztRun             `json:"basic"`
		Strict ztRun             `json:"strict"`
		Source ztCoverage        `json:"source"`
		Tests  *ztCoverage       `json:"tests"`
	} `json:"strictness"`
	Metrics []struct {
		Name     string `json:"name"`
		Measures []struct {
			Path   string `json:"path"`
			Kind   string `json:"kind"`
			Line   int    `json:"line"`
			Column int    `json:"column"`
			Value  int    `json:"value"`
			Name   string `json:"name"`
		} `json:"measures"`
		Unparsed   []string `json:"unparsed"`
		Dropped    int      `json:"dropped"`
		Unreadable int      `json:"unreadable"`
		Many       int      `json:"many"`
	} `json:"metrics"`
	Native []struct {
		Name  string            `json:"name"`
		Files map[string]string `json:"files"`
	} `json:"native"`
}

func ztFindings(fs []resultset.Finding) any {
	if len(fs) > 20 {
		return map[string]any{"count": len(fs), "first": ztFindings(fs[:2]), "last": ztFindings(fs[len(fs)-2:])}
	}
	out := []map[string]any{}
	for _, f := range fs {
		m := map[string]any{
			"rule": *f.RuleID, "title": f.Title, "message": f.Message, "gate": f.Gate, "severity": f.Severity,
			"confidence": f.Confidence, "kind": f.Kind, "in_test_code": f.InTestCode,
			"fingerprint": f.Fingerprint.Value, "limitations": f.Limitations,
		}
		if len(f.Locations) > 0 {
			l := f.Locations[0]
			m["path"], m["sha"] = l.Path, l.FileSHA256
			if l.Start != nil {
				m["line"] = l.Start.Line
				if l.Start.Column != nil {
					m["column"] = *l.Start.Column
				}
			}
		}
		if len(f.Evidence) > 0 {
			m["evidence"], m["origin"], m["trust"] = f.Evidence[0].Text, f.Evidence[0].Origin, f.Evidence[0].Trust
		}
		out = append(out, m)
	}
	return out
}

func ztResult(res *Result) map[string]any {
	m := map[string]any{
		"status": res.Status, "reasonCode": res.ReasonCode, "reason": res.Reason, "command": res.Command,
		"findings": ztFindings(res.Findings),
	}
	if res.Tool != nil {
		t := map[string]any{"name": res.Tool.Name}
		if res.Tool.Version != nil {
			t["version"] = *res.Tool.Version
		}
		if res.Tool.ExitCode != nil {
			t["exit"] = *res.Tool.ExitCode
		}
		m["tool"] = t
	}
	var lims []map[string]any
	for _, l := range res.Limitations {
		c := ""
		if l.CheckID != nil {
			c = *l.CheckID
		}
		lims = append(lims, map[string]any{"code": l.ReasonCode, "message": l.Message, "check": c})
	}
	m["limitations"] = lims
	var arts []map[string]any
	for _, a := range res.Artifacts {
		arts = append(arts, map[string]any{"id": a.ID, "path": a.Path, "mediaType": a.MediaType, "content": string(a.Content)})
	}
	m["artifacts"] = arts
	var tools []map[string]any
	for _, c := range res.ContextTools {
		d := ""
		if c.Digest != nil {
			d = *c.Digest
		}
		tools = append(tools, map[string]any{"name": c.Name, "version": c.Version, "digest": d})
	}
	m["contextTools"] = tools
	var metrics []map[string]any
	for _, x := range res.Metrics {
		e := map[string]any{"name": x.Name, "unit": x.Unit, "value": nil, "reason": nil}
		if x.Value != nil {
			e["value"] = *x.Value
		}
		if x.Reason != nil {
			e["reason"] = *x.Reason
		}
		metrics = append(metrics, e)
	}
	m["metrics"] = metrics
	if res.Inventory != nil {
		m["inventory"] = map[string]any{
			"suppressions": res.Inventory.Suppressions, "file_hashes": res.Inventory.FileHashes, "size": res.Inventory.Size,
		}
	}
	return m
}

func ztTSC(r ztRun) string {
	out := r.Out
	if r.Many != nil {
		for i := 1; i <= r.Many.Count; i++ {
			out += fmt.Sprintf("%s(%d,1): error %s: Parameter 'p%d' implicitly has an 'any' type.\n", r.Many.Path, i, r.Many.Code, i)
		}
	}
	for i := 1; i <= r.Resolution; i++ {
		out += fmt.Sprintf("src/a.ts(%d,1): error TS2307: Cannot find module '@app/m%d' or its corresponding type declarations.\n", i, i-1)
	}
	return out
}

func ztTscRun(r ztRun) tscRun {
	diags, global := parseTSC(ztTSC(r))
	return tscRun{Diagnostics: diags, Global: global, Exit: r.Exit}
}

func ztInput(t *testing.T, files map[string]string, pkg string) *Input {
	t.Helper()
	if pkg == "" {
		pkg = "."
	}
	proj, dir := writeTree(t, files)
	return &Input{Project: proj, Context: packageContext(t, proj, pkg), OriginalPath: "/original", SnapshotDir: dir}
}

func TestZZTypesQualityOracle(t *testing.T) {
	raw, err := os.ReadFile("testdata/types-quality-oracle-cases.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var cases ztCases
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	out := map[string]any{}

	var supp []map[string]int
	for _, c := range cases.Suppressions {
		supp = append(supp, countSuppressions([]byte(c)))
	}
	out["suppressions"] = supp

	var roles []string
	for _, c := range cases.Roles {
		roles = append(roles, configRole(c))
	}
	out["roles"] = roles

	var lines [][]int
	for _, c := range cases.Lines {
		n := countLines([]byte(c))
		lines = append(lines, []int{n.lines, n.nonBlank})
	}
	out["lines"] = lines

	var pcts []int
	for _, c := range cases.Percentiles {
		sorted := append([]int{}, c.Values...)
		sort.Ints(sorted)
		pcts = append(pcts, percentile(sorted, c.P))
	}
	out["percentiles"] = pcts

	var covs []map[string]any
	for _, c := range cases.TypeCoverage {
		got, err := parseTypeCoverage([]byte(c))
		m := map[string]any{"error": err != nil}
		if err != nil {
			m["errorText"] = err.Error()
		} else {
			m["correct"], m["total"], m["percent"] = got.Correct, got.Total, got.Percent()
		}
		covs = append(covs, m)
	}
	out["typeCoverage"] = covs

	var types []map[string]any
	for _, c := range cases.Types {
		in := ztInput(t, c.Files, c.Pkg)
		diags, global := parseTSC(ztTSC(c.Run))
		types = append(types, ztResult(interpretTypes(in, diags, global, c.Run.Exit)))
	}
	out["types"] = types

	var strict []map[string]any
	for _, c := range cases.Strictness {
		in := ztInput(t, c.Files, ".")
		var tests *typeCoverage
		if c.Tests != nil {
			tests = &typeCoverage{Correct: c.Tests.Correct, Total: c.Tests.Total}
		}
		strict = append(strict, ztResult(interpretStrictness(in, ztTscRun(c.Basic), ztTscRun(c.Strict),
			typeCoverage{Correct: c.Source.Correct, Total: c.Source.Total}, tests)))
	}
	out["strictness"] = strict

	var metrics []map[string]any
	for _, c := range cases.Metrics {
		in := ztInput(t, map[string]string{"package.json": `{"name":"x"}`, "src/a.js": "1;\n"}, ".")
		var ms []eslintMeasure
		for _, m := range c.Measures {
			ms = append(ms, eslintMeasure{Path: m.Path, Kind: m.Kind, Line: m.Line, Column: m.Column, Value: m.Value, Name: m.Name})
		}
		for i := 1; i <= c.Many; i++ {
			ms = append(ms, eslintMeasure{Path: "src/a.js", Kind: "cyclomatic", Line: i, Column: 1, Value: i % 30, Name: "f"},
				eslintMeasure{Path: "src/a.js", Kind: "length", Line: i, Column: 1, Value: i % 70, Name: "f"})
		}
		run := &eslintRun{
			Output: eslintOutput{
				Version: "10.13.0", Groups: map[string][]string{"quality.metrics": {"complexity", "max-lines-per-function", "sonarjs/cognitive-complexity"}},
				Config: map[string]any{"eslint": "10.13.0"}, Measures: ms, MeasuresDropped: c.Dropped, MeasuresUnreadable: c.Unreadable,
			},
			ConfigSHA256: "abc123",
		}
		for _, p := range c.Unparsed {
			run.Output.Results = append(run.Output.Results, eslintFileResult{Path: p, Messages: []eslintMessage{{Fatal: true, Message: "Parsing error"}}})
		}
		metrics = append(metrics, ztResult(interpretQualityMetrics(in, run)))
	}
	out["metrics"] = metrics

	var native []map[string]any
	for _, c := range cases.Native {
		proj, dir := writeTree(t, c.Files)
		ctx := &proj.Contexts[0]
		m := map[string]any{}
		for _, id := range []string{"quality.size", "quality.suppressions"} {
			res := Implementation(id).Run(context.Background(), &Input{Project: proj, Context: ctx, SnapshotDir: dir, OriginalPath: dir})
			m[id] = ztResult(res)
		}
		var classes []string
		for _, f := range proj.Files {
			classes = append(classes, f.Path+"="+string(f.Class))
		}
		sort.Strings(classes)
		m["classes"] = strings.Join(classes, ",")
		native = append(native, m)
	}
	out["native"] = native

	data, err := json.Marshal(out)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile("testdata/types-quality-oracle.json", append(data, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
